title: Engram's full gate never gets a verification record: its clippy and docs stages are unclassified, so the record stays pending (unclassified_stages)
outcome: Engram's full gate never gets a verification record: its clippy and docs stages are unclassified, so the record stays pending (unclassified_stages)
acceptance: Engram's full-gate clippy and docs stages are classified by their exact actual argv (agreed with Engram: for example clippy's exact cargo clippy argv with its deny-warnings flags as Lint, and the docs stage's exact command as Lint or Build), with no wrapper, extra argument or write form admitted; a test drives an Engram-shaped full results file with those stages and shows a verification record is built (passed or failed as the stages say) instead of pending unclassified_stages.
An unknown stage still leaves the run pending with unclassified_stages, never silently dropped; a test shows it.

A run already left pending before this change can be settled by the existing recovery path once its stages classify, without editing its original results or record state; a test or a documented recovery step shows it.
